# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old when introduced, sixteen when moving to Boston  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Domestic servant  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a snub nose, freckles, a broad mouth, and wide, broad smiles. In her youth, she wore her hair in crinkly braids tied with four massive blue ribbon bows, and dressed in heavily starched white dresses. As she grew into a young woman, she abandoned her blue bows and adopted a massive pompadour hairstyle.

_Sources: [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Belinda is an energetic, hard-working, and fiercely loyal handmaiden who deeply cherishes her mistress. She has a matter-of-fact and pragmatic disposition, though she is prone to anxiety and tragic forebodings prior to major events. She greatly admires Nell Harcourt and attempts to imitate her graceful manners and speech.

_Sources: [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)_

- To serve and protect the well-being of Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>
- To learn to walk, talk, and act with the grace of Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050)</sub>

## History

Belinda lived at Echo Cottage as the handmaiden to Miss Rosalind Harcourt, where she was given the designation 'Belinda the Fourth' to follow her three older sisters who had previously served there. She diligently assisted Miss Rosalind with domestic tasks, garden work, and playing along with her imaginative tea parties. When Miss Rosalind grew sick and weary, Belinda privately shared her deep worries with Nell Harcourt. She enthusiastically supported the romantic reunion between Miss Rosalind and Stephen Stanhope, helping Nell polish silver while the proposal took place. Following Miss Rosalind's garden wedding, Belinda moved to Boston in the autumn to continue residing with the newlyweds. Though initially homesick for St. Brendan's Island, she returned to Echo Cottage each summer with the Stanhopes. Eventually, she married a American bricklayer named Tom, though she maintained that she never intended to take a 'Yankee' as a husband. She attended Nell's wedding at Grey Shutters, where she joyously helped toss rice and old shoes as the couple departed.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P68](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0068), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010), [v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest and finest daughter of Mrs. Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Her elder sisters Belinda, Julietta, and Evelina previously served at Echo Cottage  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She went to reside at Echo Cottage at age fourteen in exchange for room, board, and clothing  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> Miss Rosalind is sick, Miss Harcourt, ma’am. Though she keeps it to herself, I am certain of it.  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

> That will be the very thing, Miss Harcourt, ma’am  <sub>[v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050)</sub>

> When everything is finished, Miss Harcourt, ma'am, a wedding isn't really much happier than a funeral.  <sub>[v2 c30 P35](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0035)</sub>

> Taking everything into account, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, I haven’t come across a single person in Boston who compares to you  <sub>[v3 c40 P1](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0001)</sub>

> I certainly never believed I would descend to taking a Yankee as my husband, Miss Harcourt, ma’am  <sub>[v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038)</sub>
